en: Abu Yusuf Yaqub ibn Ishaq al-Kindi
tr: Ebû Yûsuf Ya'kūb b. İshâk el-Kindî
ar: أبو يوسف يعقوب بن إسحاق الكندي

description.tr: 'Arap Filozofu' — Yunan felsefesini Arapçada ilk sistematize eden, ve şifre kırmak için frekans analizini icat eden (modern kriptografinin temeli) || Kindî, Arapça'da sistematik olarak yazan ilk filozof olarak merkezi bir konuma sahiptir. Yeni-Platoncu sudûr teorisini İslam monoteizmine uyarladı ve Fârâbî, İbn Sînâ ve İbn Rüşd'ün rafine edeceği felsefi terminolojiyi kurdu. || [Tarih notu] Adamson'ın Al-Kindi (2007) eseri, onu küçük bir geçiş figüründen büyük bir özgün düşünüre yeniden konumlandırdı.
description.en: The 'Philosopher of the Arabs' — first to systematize Greek philosophy in Arabic, and inventor of frequency analysis for breaking ciphers (the foundation of modern cryptography) || Kindi occupies a pivotal position as the first philosopher to write systematically in Arabic. He adapted Neoplatonic emanation theory to Islamic monotheism and established the philosophical vocabulary that Farabi, Ibn Sina, and Ibn Rushd would refine. His cryptanalysis treatise is the earliest known work to use letter-frequency analysis. || [Historiographical note] Adamson's Al-Kindi (2007) repositioned him from a minor transitional figure to a major original thinker. The cryptanalysis work, published by Mrayati et al. (2002), demonstrated Kindi's mathematical sophistication was previously underestimated.
description.ar: فيلسوف العرب — أول من نظّم الفلسفة اليونانية بالعربية، ومخترع تحليل التكرار لكسر الشفرات || الكندي أول فيلسوف كتب منهجيًا بالعربية. كيّف نظرية الفيض الأفلاطونية المحدثة مع التوحيد الإسلامي ووضع المصطلحات الفلسفية التي طوّرها الفارابي وابن سينا وابن رشد
